lines.quote: Implemented a digital beamforming algorithm for a 16-element L-band phased-array receiver used in a coastal maritime surveillance prototype.
Wrote the spatial filtering and beam-scheduling code in C for a TI C6678 multi-core DSP, achieving real-time operation at 10 MHz sampling per channel.
Built the production Python pipeline (SciPy, NumPy, Celery, PostgreSQL) for automated ship detection from SAR imagery.
Used an Agilent E5071C network analyser for S-parameter measurement of the LNA cascade and filter stages.

requirements.name: Satellite or airborne platform experience
requirements.note: Cover letter explicitly distinguishes processing satellite-derived data from working on satellite instruments ("I know the output of spaceborne SAR instruments intimately, but I have never worked on the instruments themselves"); no evidence of having worked on an instrument or system that itself flew on a satellite or aircraft platform, so marked not_stated rather than evidence_found.
